name: agent-runtime
description: gRPC agent session runtime for the PolyAgent platform, built on pi-ai/pi-agent-core

scripts.sync-proto: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Duke-ECE/protos/v0.9.3/proto/runtime/v1/agent.proto -o proto/runtime/v1/agent.proto && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Duke-ECE/protos/v0.9.3/proto/session/v1/session.proto -o proto/session/v1/session.proto && mkdir -p proto/sandbox/v3 && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Duke-ECE/protos/v0.9.3/proto/sandbox/v3/session_sandbox.proto -o proto/sandbox/v3/session_sandbox.proto
